title: Trump-backed Byron Donalds to make history as Florida’s first Black governor
summary: Byron Donalds makes history as the first Black Republican governor in the nation, defeating David Jolly in Florida's heated gubernatorial race.

title: Dem flips key Senate seat in battleground North Carolina as Cooper defeats Trump ally
summary: Former Democratic Gov. Roy Cooper defeated Michael Whatley in North Carolina's Senate race after top GOP-aligned groups pulled spending a month ago.

title: Trump touts 'ultimate power' of veto if Democrats win control of House and Senate
summary: President Donald Trump declared he has "the ultimate power" of the veto to block Democratic legislation if the GOP loses control of Congress.

title: Democrats score major Senate victory as Pappas defeats Trump-backed Republican in key battleground
summary: Democratic Rep. Chris Pappas defeats John Sununu in New Hampshire's high-stakes Senate race, a critical hold as Democrats seek the Senate majority.

title: Georgia Senator Warnock says only a 'spiritually sick' country would elect Trump twice
summary: Sen. Raphael Warnock called President Donald Trump a symptom of a "spiritually sick" nation and urged Democrats to hold a robust primary and debate ahead of 2028.

title: Trump admin puts alleged 'Decoy Dan' conspirators on notice in Alaska election spoiler probe
summary: The Justice Department has issued more than 120 subpoenas and 20 target letters in its probe of Daniel J. Sullivan's Alaska Senate candidacy.

title: Talarico warms to Trump, says he wants to help fulfill some MAGA promises
summary: James Talarico told the "Diary of a CEO" podcast he'd work with Trump on healthcare, housing and childcare despite months of attacks from the president.

title: Trump says Israel will stop receiving $4B in US aid by year's end, can still buy weapons
summary: President Donald Trump says Benjamin Netanyahu raised the idea of ending $4 billion in U.S. military aid to Israel by the end of the year.

title: Federal judge tosses Trump admin Harvard admissions lawsuit, leaves door open to future challenge
summary: A federal judge dismissed the Trump administration's lawsuit against Harvard University over admissions records, citing procedural deficiencies.

title: Super Bowl champion Russell Wilson reportedly in the mix for NC State head-coaching job
summary: Russell Wilson interviewed for the NC State head coaching job, barely two months into his CBS studio role, despite never coaching a single snap.
